mapper.sql: SELECT partenName AS `学院`, deptName AS `专业`, SUM(zcgjjjkyxm + zcsbjjjkyxm + zcsbjjgxm + zcsbjzxkyxm + zctjjxhjkyxm ) AS `纵向科研项目-校级以上`, SUM(zcxjjxglxmywyys + zcxjjxglxmywyyx) AS `纵向科研项目-校级`, SUM(ewyyx + edwwy + wdswy + sdeswy + esdsswwy + wswwydwswy + wsdqswwy + qswdybwy ) AS `横向课题科研项目`, SUM(eyxxx + edwxx + wdsxx + sdesxx + esdsswxx + sswdwsxx + dywsxx ) AS `成果转化`, SUM(SCI + EI + hx + sw + pt + xb ) AS `学术论文`, SUM(cbzz1 + cbzz2+ cbyz1+ cbyz2 ) AS `专著`, SUM(cbjc1 + cbjc2 + zbjc) AS `教材`, SUM(sqfmzl + syxxzl + wxsjzl ) AS `专利`, SUM(jsjrjzzq ) AS `软著`, SUM(sjjxcgj + sjkxjsj + sjyljpkpb + stjjzrkxlpj + stjjsklpj + xjjxcgj + yyxkyxjcgj + xjjpkpb + jscjsjdshj ) AS `奖励`, SUM(jbgj + jbgn + cjgj + cjgn + xjxs ) AS `学术报告(讲座类)` FROM Alltotle
mapper.select: WHERE partenId = #{dept} GROUP BY partenName, deptName
mapper.sql:
SELECT SUM(COALESCE(zcgjjjkyxm, 0)) + SUM(COALESCE(zcsbjjjkyxm, 0)) + SUM(COALESCE(zcsbjjgxm, 0)) + SUM(COALESCE(zcsbjzxkyxm, 0)) + SUM(COALESCE(zctjjxhjkyxm, 0)) AS '纵向科研项目-校级以上',
SUM(COALESCE(zcxjjxglxmywyys, 0)) + SUM(COALESCE(zcxjjxglxmywyyx, 0)) AS '纵向科研项目-校级',
SUM(COALESCE(ewyyx, 0)) + SUM(COALESCE(edwwy, 0)) + SUM(COALESCE(wdswy, 0)) + SUM(COALESCE(sdeswy, 0)) + SUM(COALESCE(esdsswwy, 0)) + SUM(COALESCE(wswwydwswy, 0)) + SUM(COALESCE(wsdqswwy, 0)) + SUM(COALESCE(qswdybwy, 0)) AS '横向课题科研项目',
SUM(COALESCE(eyxxx, 0)) + SUM(COALESCE(edwxx, 0)) + SUM(COALESCE(wdsxx, 0)) + SUM(COALESCE(sdesxx, 0)) + SUM(COALESCE(esdsswxx, 0)) + SUM(COALESCE(sswdwsxx, 0)) + SUM(COALESCE(dywsxx, 0)) AS '成果转化',
SUM(COALESCE(SCI, 0)) + SUM(COALESCE(EI, 0)) + SUM(COALESCE(hx, 0)) + SUM(COALESCE(sw, 0)) + SUM(COALESCE(pt, 0)) + SUM(COALESCE(xb, 0)) AS '学术论文',
SUM(COALESCE(zz, 0)) + SUM(COALESCE(jc, 0)) AS '教材著作',
SUM(COALESCE(sqfmzl, 0)) + SUM(COALESCE(syxxzl, 0)) + SUM(COALESCE(wxsjzl, 0)) AS '专利',
SUM(COALESCE(sjjxcgj, 0)) AS '软著',
SUM(COALESCE(sjjxcgj, 0)) + SUM(COALESCE(sjkxjsj, 0)) + SUM(COALESCE(sjyljpkpb, 0)) + SUM(COALESCE(stjjzrkxlpj, 0)) + SUM(COALESCE(stjjsklpj, 0)) + SUM(COALESCE(xjjxcgj, 0)) + SUM(COALESCE(yyxkyxjcgj, 0)) + SUM(COALESCE(xjjpkpb, 0)) + SUM(COALESCE(jscjsjdshj, 0)) AS '奖励',
SUM(COALESCE(jbgj, 0)) + SUM(COALESCE(jbgn, 0)) + SUM(COALESCE(cjgj, 0)) + SUM(COALESCE(cjgn, 0)) + SUM(COALESCE(xjxs, 0)) AS '学术报告(讲座类)' FROM Alltotle
mapper.select:
SELECT `学院`, `专业`, `纵向科研项目-校级以上`, `纵向科研项目-校级`, `横向课题科研项目`, `成果转化`, `学术论文`, `专著`, `教材`, `专利`, `软著`, `奖励`, `学术报告(讲座类)` FROM (
partenId IN (1139, 1140,1147,1145,1150,1155,1143,1149)
partenId = #{dept}
GROUP BY partenName, deptName ) tmp
